text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Maya's reached the chapel by
now?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Эйр Грув, Dober, Kawakami,
and everyone else will pass
the audition.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! It'll be super buono to be able to
see everyone in their
dresses!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
You know, when I was younger, I wanted
to be that biiig hot pot they
always make
for sumo wrestlers—chanko.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Eating delicious food makes people
happy, and I really liked the
thought of
seeing everyone full of joy.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Plus, eating chanko makes you big and
strong! And what's more
buono than being
strong and happy? ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Awww, that's so like you, Bono. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Wait... Then why did you decide to enter
Tracen Academy? Does it
have something
to do with hot pot?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Not at all. I gave up on my chanko dream. I mean, if I'm the hot pot, I wouldn't get to have any myself!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm buono and everyone else is
buono, then it's all good!
That's why I
came here. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Don't you think races are kinda like
chanko? They both put smiles on
people's
faces and help you grow stronger along
with your friends. ♪
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
It's okay... I'm fine. Everything's buono,
buono!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: No, it's not!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Maya! What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
You have to hurry back! You won't be able
to finish in first place if
you don't!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: No! I've made up my mind! We're going to get to the chapel together!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Don't you remember how you said it'd be
buono if we all got our own
dresses?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
If you don't pass this audition, it won't be
buono at all!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure? Is it... really okay for me
to keep trying?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Of course!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Are you okay? Should we rest for a bit?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. I don't want to be a burden
on you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Don't say that! It's not good to push
yourself!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Let's take a break when we reach that river
over there. You copy?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Urgh... Copy that...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Maya... I'm sorry for causing so much
trouble for you.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
If we don't reach the goal quickly, we'll
lose the chance to wear Ms.
Beauty's
racewear, yet here I am, dragging us both
down...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
Heeey, stop that! You haven't caused me
any trouble!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I do want that racewear. A
grown-up outfit like that would
really
make me shine.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But if I abandoned you here, I wouldn't be
fit to wear a such a twinkly
outfit!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I view being a mature, sophisticated
woman the same way you see
races!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
It's not enough if I'm the only one happy—I
want everyone to be
happy and twinkle
like the sun!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Maya...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
(The truth is, I was so upset... I really
didn't want to retire from the
race.)
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to compete in the audition,
become a muse, and race in a
wedding
dress with everyone else.)
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Maya.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Let's become muses
together, Bono!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Neither of them have arrived yet.
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
We should probably send out a search and
rescue team soon...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Buono, buono!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Buono, buono! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, we made it! ♪ The main character
always arrives last!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? Do you have
any idea how worried we
were?!
text_block_list.name: Каваками Принцесс

text_block_list.text:
Ms. Beauty is waiting for you in the chapel.
Go on and tell her your
true feelings!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oookay! ♪ Ready, Maya?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Ready! Let's take off towards Beauty! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
